I queried STRING v12 directly via `mcp__biomni__query_stringdb`, using the **physical subnetwork** (`network_type=physical`), which restricts evidence to "these proteins are part of the same complex" rather than STRING's default functional association.

**Endpoint actually called** (returned in `query_info`):
`https://string-db.org/api/json/interaction_partners?identifiers=TP53&species=9606&limit=100&network_type=physical`
TP53 = `9606.ENSP00000269305` (UniProt P04637).

### Important caveat about "top by confidence"

STRING's combined score **saturates at 0.999**, and **73 of the 100 partners returned are tied at exactly 0.999** — so there is no meaningful rank order at the top, and the raw API ordering within the tie is by Ensembl protein ID, not by confidence. My first call (limit=10) returned only an arbitrary alphabetical-by-ID slice of that tie and omitted MDM2 entirely; that is why I re-ran it at limit=100.

To break the tie I sorted the 0.999 group by the two independent evidence channels that do vary: `dscore` (curated pathway-database evidence) then `tscore` (text-mining). That ordering is my choice, stated so you can discount it.

### Top physical partners of p53 (all score = 0.999 unless noted)

| Rank | Partner | combined | experimental | curated DB | text-mining | Nature of interaction |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **MDM2** | 0.999 | 0.999 | 0.70 | 0.93 | E3 ligase, binds TAD; master negative regulator |
| 2 | **BCL2** | 0.999 | 0.999 | 0.90 | 0.68 | Cytoplasmic/mitochondrial apoptotic complex |
| 3 | **MDM4** (MDMX) | 0.999 | 0.999 | 0.70 | 0.76 | MDM2 paralogue, binds same TAD pocket |
| 4 | **CREBBP** (CBP) | 0.999 | 0.999 | 0.70 | 0.64 | Acetyltransferase/coactivator |
| 5 | **SUMO1** | 0.999 | 0.999 | 0.90 | 0.11 | Covalent SUMOylation at K386 |
| 6 | **EP300** (p300) | 0.999 | 0.999 | 0.50 | 0.66 | Acetyltransferase/coactivator |
| 7 | **TP63** / **TP73** | 0.999 | 0.999 | 0.70 / 0.50 | 0.10 / 0 | Family paralogues, hetero-oligomerisation |
| 8 | **COP1** (RFWD2) | 0.999 | 0.999 | 0.70 | 0 | E3 ligase |
| 9 | **MAPK8** (JNK1) | 0.999 | 0.999 | 0.70 | 0.20 | Kinase, phosphorylates/targets p53 |
| 10 | **TP53BP2** (ASPP2) | 0.999 | 0.999 | 0.50 | 0.60 | Binds DNA-binding domain, stimulates transactivation |
| 11 | **USP7** (HAUSP) | 0.999 | 0.999 | 0.50 | 0.37 | Deubiquitinase, stabilises p53 |
| 12 | **CDKN2A** (p14ARF) | 0.999 | 0.999 | 0.50 | 0.52 | Sequesters MDM2 / p53 complex |

Also in the same 0.999 tier, with strong experimental support but no curated-DB score: **SIRT1, ATM, ATR, CHEK1, CHEK2, HIPK2, PML, DAXX, HDAC1/2, SP1, YY1, TBP, NPM1, BRCA1, BRCA2, RPA1, PRKDC, RAD51, CSNK2A1, STUB1, RCHY1 (Pirh2), COPS5, UBE2I, PIAS1, RPL5, RPL11, HIF1A, CDKN1A, KAT2B, KAT5, SETD7, SMARCA4, SFN (14-3-3σ), USP10, HSP90AA1, HSPA4/8/9, DDX5, BAK1, BCL2L1, MAPK1, MAPK14, AURKA, CUL7, CUL9, TP53BP1, UBE3A, BLM, PTK2, PTGS2, S100A4, ING4, TAF9, PPP1R13L (iASPP), RPS27A, NUMB**.

Just below the tie (useful because the scores actually separate): GTF2H1 0.998, FOXO3 0.998, PIN1 0.997, SMAD2 0.997, BAX 0.997, PPM1D 0.997, TADA3 0.997, PARP1 0.997, SMYD2 0.997, ESR1 0.997, BRD4 0.996, CDK2 0.995, MRE11 0.995, CREB1 0.995, TRIM28 0.994, HERC2 0.993, BARD1 0.992, NQO1 0.990, HNRNPK 0.989, CDK1 0.988, VRK1 0.987, HMGB1 0.987, HSPB1 0.986.

Two things to keep in mind: the physical subnetwork means "co-complex," not necessarily direct binary binding — chaperones (HSPA*, HSP90AA1) and ribosomal proteins partly reflect affinity-capture MS co-isolation. And p53 is one of the most-studied proteins in existence, so its interactome is both genuinely large and inflated by literature bias; a low-throughput-only view (IntAct/BioGRID with method filters) would give a shorter list. I don't have an IntAct or BioGRID tool in this session, so I did not cross-check there.

Top p53 (TP53, P04637) physical interactors in STRING v12 (human, `network_type=physical`), ranked within the saturated 0.999 confidence tier by curated-database + text-mining evidence:

**MDM2, BCL2, MDM4 (MDMX), CREBBP (CBP), SUMO1, EP300 (p300), TP63, TP73, COP1/RFWD2, MAPK8 (JNK1), TP53BP2 (ASPP2), USP7, CDKN2A (p14ARF)** — all combined score 0.999, experimental score 0.999.

Caveat: 73 of 100 partners tie at the 0.999 ceiling (SIRT1, ATM, CHEK2, PML, DAXX, HDAC1, BRCA1, CDKN1A and ~60 more), so "top few" is not strictly orderable from the STRING score alone; the ranking above uses secondary evidence channels. Source: STRING API `interaction_partners`, TP53 = 9606.ENSP00000269305.
